title: Explicit Hamiltonian ball packings in every dimension
description:
Version 1.1.0. Four papers, supplements, a Lean 4 formalisation and two accompanying programs, by Liang Song.

Paper I (equal balls in the four-ball): for every integer k ≥ 10 and ε ∈ (0,1), one explicit smooth compactly supported Hamiltonian whose time-one map packs the k closed unit balls in the four-ball of radius (k/(1-ε/4))1/4, with density 1-ε/4 and an explicit stability margin, via a linear comparison identity and a cube-root-symmetric return from the Fermat cubic disc bundle. Paper II (general capacities and higher dimensions): one explicit Hamiltonian for all admissible data, realising in dimension four every packing with Σci2 < C2, 3ci < C (proving Biran's full-packing theorem for k ≥ 9 equal balls without J-holomorphic curves or Seiberg–Witten theory), and in dimensions 2n ≥ 6 every packing allowed by the volume and two-ball inequalities; plus a uniform terminating algorithm outputting a rational polynomial times a fixed cutoff. Paper III (elementary packings of the four-ball and their limits): n(n+1) balls at density 1-1/(2n+1)2, density ≥ 1-1/√k for every k, ten balls at 360/361, and three obstructions explaining the density limits of lattice, balanced-profile, and 8-column constructions. Paper IV (closed-form symplectic packings of the four-ball by equal balls): complete exact-real proof for an ODE-free C4 symplectic embedding chain and its left inverse for all k ≥ 10 and ε ∈ (0,1).

The main theorems of Papers I and II are verified in Lean 4 against a Mathlib-only specification; the Lean development is byte-identical to version 1.0.1. Papers III and IV are not formalised in Lean. program/ provides two accompanying PyTorch implementations—solution_epoch.py (fast elementary-flow Hamiltonians in Epoch's ODE interface over covered (k, ε) ranges) and solution_embedding.py (built from modular sources in program/embedding_src/, implementing Paper IV with float64 and direct 100-digit mpmath checkers)—documented in program/README.md.

Changes from 1.0.1. The single paper is split into Paper I and Paper II; Papers III and IV and program/ are new; Lean sources, statements and proofs are unchanged. See PROVENANCE.md.

Source and verification guide: https://github.com/s-JoL/Symplectic-Ball-Packing. License: Apache-2.0; vendored components retain their original notices.
